title: Scroll the product catalogue with touch gestures on a phone
steps: Swipe upward across the visible product rows.

video_guide.summary: The orange circle and trail visualize the recorded touch gesture. The upward swipe leaves All products and opens a product detail page.

chapters.note: All products and the Travel Shoe Bag row are visible in the phone-sized viewport.

chapters.label: Swipe upward across a product row

chapters.note: An orange touch circle and upward trail overlay a product row; these are recording annotations.
The product detail page begins loading after the gesture; the retained orange trail marks the original touch.
The touch annotation has cleared; the product detail page is visible with Finish setting up this product, and All products has been left.
